char_13.name: The Branded
char_13.flavor: The runes predate the dungeon. When he speaks it is a statement, never a question.

char_11.name: Valdrath
char_11.flavor: Enormous chip on his shoulder. Furious at being underestimated. Usually right.

char_14.name: Morra
char_14.flavor: The only one here doing her job correctly. Perpetually furious about it.

char_12.name: Vex
char_12.flavor: Where Valdrath is all rage, she is all patience. Speaks rarely and only to devastate.

char_10.name: Skarrix
char_10.flavor: Cold, precise. Speaks like every word costs something.

The Thornpass.title: The Thornpass
The Thornpass.loreInfo: A narrow mountain pass used by the surface army for supply caravans, named for the thornbriar that grows along its walls. Valdrath has scouted it three times at night without being detected. He finds this less impressive than everyone else does, since he considers not being detected the bare minimum standard for competence.

The Champion's Gauntlet.title: The Champion's Gauntlet
The Champion's Gauntlet.loreInfo: Left outside the Overlord's door by The Branded after his solo engagement with the surface champion. The gauntlet is undamaged. The champion is not available for comment.

Morra's Protocols.title: Morra's Protocols
Morra's Protocols.loreInfo: A seventeen-volume operational manual covering dungeon defense, patrol scheduling, trap maintenance, and the correct way to hold a torch so you don't trip over your own feet in the dark. Volume nine is dedicated entirely to gates and why they must remain closed. It was written after the bucket incident. It is very thorough.

The Shadow Network.title: The Shadow Network
The Shadow Network.loreInfo: Skarrix's web of informants, cutpurses, and compromised nobles stretching from the dungeon to the surface courts. Nobody knows its full extent. Including Skarrix, who lost the ledger sometime during the third siege and has been improvising since.

The Branded Marks.title: The Branded Marks
The Branded Marks.loreInfo: Ritual sigils carved into The Branded's flesh over centuries of service to something older than language. Each mark holds a different thing at bay. He has never written down what any of them mean. He considers this responsible contingency planning.

The Infiltrated Order.title: The Infiltrated Order
The Infiltrated Order.loreInfo: A splinter cell of the Order of the Light whose upper ranks have been quietly replaced by Skarrix's agents over four years. They still send holy pamphlets to the dungeon. Skarrix files them under 'operational humor.'

The Bucket Incident.title: The Bucket Incident
The Bucket Incident.loreInfo: Classified. Morra has requested this entry remain blank. The entry is blank. The fact that the entry exists is itself considered a violation of operational security and she has filed a formal complaint about it with the Complaints Committee, who have not yet read it because they are afraid of her.

Vex's Floor.title: Vex's Floor
Vex's Floor.loreInfo: The single floor Vex was given command of is the quietest in the dungeon. Nothing has breached it. No patrol has failed. The goblins stationed there stand straight, speak in measured tones, and refuse to discuss what the first week of training was like. They seem fine. Probably fine.

The Kobold Question.title: The Kobold Question
The Kobold Question.loreInfo: An ongoing philosophical debate in dungeon culture about whether kobolds count as 'real' dungeon inhabitants or merely 'very aggressive furniture.' Valdrath is aware of this debate. He has opinions. They are expressed primarily through jaw-breaking.

The Deep Cartography.title: The Deep Cartography
The Deep Cartography.loreInfo: Vex's ongoing project to map the lower depths below the dungeon's known foundations. Current status: seventeen floors charted, four floors that 'resist notation,' and one floor that appeared on the map before she visited it. She has not visited it yet. She is thinking about it.

The Old Compact.title: The Old Compact
The Old Compact.loreInfo: An agreement struck before the dungeon existed, between The Branded and entities whose names have since been removed from every text that mentioned them. The terms are unknown. The Branded honors it regardless. He finds questions about it tedious.

The Lower Watching.title: The Lower Watching
The Lower Watching.loreInfo: Whatever dwells beneath the eastern patrol routes has been there longer than the dungeon's foundations. It has never attacked. It has never communicated. It simply observes. Vex went down alone to look at it. She came back two days later and said it was waiting. Nobody asked what for. This was considered wise.

dialogues.text: The price first.
A shipment I lost. The contents are not your concern. The silence is.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Someone in your inner circle is selling information. I know who. My price is your silence on one matter.

dialogues.text: Less than a war. More than you'd like.
He has survived four years. That is its own answer.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I have placed an informant in the Order of the Light. He is very good. He is also very expensive.

dialogues.text: Someone talked. I am handling it.
We can. We lose three months of supply access. Your call.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The Sun-King knows our eastern tunnel exists. He does not yet know where it leads. We have perhaps a week.

dialogues.text: Unknown. The interesting part is who she hasn't moved against yet.

DECK_JSON.prompt: A surface assassin entered the dungeon last night. She is still here. I am watching her. Should I let her run?

nextCard.cardText: She went for the Shadow Priest. Failed. She's in a cell, keeps staring toward the merchant's corridor.

dialogues.text: You can ask.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I require three days away from the dungeon. Do not ask where. I will return with something useful.

nextCard.cardText: He returned on the third day. He left a locked chest outside your door and said nothing. The chest hums faintly.

dialogues.text: I've been ready since before you gave me this rank. Sir.

dialogues.btn: The Uruks won't follow a kobold.
dialogues.text: The Uruks will follow whoever breaks the most heads. Watch me.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I want to lead the next raid. Not assist. Lead. I'm twice the fighter of anyone you'd send.

nextCard.cardText: Came back with surface steel and a split lip. The Uruks carried him on their shoulders. He looked furious.

dialogues.text: Fitted plate. Not Orc-sized. Mine. Custom. I have measurements.

dialogues.btn: What does fixing it himself mean?
dialogues.text: I take it off whoever I beat in the pit. Starting tonight.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The big ones get the good armor. I get the scraps. Fix it or I fix it myself.

dialogues.text: Both sides. He'll eat soup for a month. He'll think twice for longer.

nextCard.cardText: He took the discipline without a word. The Vanguard watched. Three Uruks have since called him sir. Unprompted.

DECK_JSON.prompt: An Uruk called me rat-kin in front of the Vanguard. I already broke his jaw. Is that going to be a problem?

dialogues.text: Small. Quiet. Fast. Advantages nobody credits me with.
For them, yes.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I can get us through the mountain pass the surface army is using. I've scouted it three times. Alone. At night.

nextCard.cardText: He came back with a map of the supply route, three surface patrol schedules, and a black eye he refuses to explain.

dialogues.btn: What would the song be about?
dialogues.text: Everything they missed. Which is most of it.

dialogues.btn: We have a bard in the cells.
dialogues.text: I know. I've already given him the outline. He needs funding.

DECK_JSON.prompt: They wrote songs about the Orc raids. Nobody writes songs about what I do. I want a bard. A good one.

dialogues.text: Everything. Quietly.
To start.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The Orcs are loud. The goblins are endless. Give me one floor. I'll show you what discipline looks like.

dialogues.btn: How long has this been happening?
dialogues.text: Long enough that he thinks you haven't noticed. Which tells me something about you.

nextCard.cardText: She watched you burn it without expression. Later that day the merchant's prices dropped significantly. She did not mention it.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The merchant has been skimming the vault tributes. I have the ledger. What you do with it is your business.

dialogues.text: The half that survives the selection.
As long as it takes. Rushing it is how you get the current Vanguard.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I don't need more troops. I need better ones. Let me cut the Vanguard by half and triple their training.

dialogues.text: Probably. That's why I'm going alone.

dialogues.btn: What do you think it is?
dialogues.text: Something that's deciding.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Something in the lower depths has been watching the eastern patrols. Not attacking. Watching. I want to go down alone.

nextCard.cardText: Back after two days. One sentence: it's been there longer than the dungeon. It's not hostile. It's waiting.

dialogues.btn: Who's more likely to be right?
dialogues.text: Me. But his way is faster, which is why it's wrong.
That I overthink. He is not entirely incorrect.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Valdrath and I disagree on the eastern patrol routes. He is wrong. I would like this settled before someone dies proving it.

dialogues.text: Something that was here before the dungeon.
They remember.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The lower wall runes aren't decorative. Something has been feeding them. Stop it or don't. But know what you allow.

dialogues.text: I have beaten things older than his bloodline.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I will fight the surface champion. Alone. This is not a request.

nextCard.cardText: He returned before midday. No wounds. He left the champion's gauntlet outside your door and said nothing.

dialogues.text: The same way I was shown. They will not mock afterward.
The ones worth keeping will.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The young ones mock the old ways. They do not know what the old ways cost. I would like to show them.

dialogues.text: The things they hold back stop being held back.
Most of them.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The brands are fading. The ritual requires blood. Mine is no longer enough. I need volunteers.

nextCard.cardText: Brands hold. Fourteen went in. Eleven came out. The three who didn't are part of the walls now. Literally.

dialogues.text: I always come back.
You should always be worried. That is unrelated to this.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I am leaving for three days. Do not send anyone after me. Do not ask where I am going.

dialogues.text: Because I fixed it before it became a crisis. That is apparently invisible.

dialogues.btn: Who was supposed to man it?
dialogues.text: Three separate units. All with excellent excuses.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The east barricade has been unmanned for six days. I have been covering it myself. I would like this acknowledged.

dialogues.text: That I am relentless, joyless, and make them run laps at midnight. All correct.
The drills are exactly hard enough. The Vanguard is too soft.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The Vanguard filed a formal complaint about my drills. In writing. On parchment. I need a moment.

nextCard.cardText: Three weeks later the Vanguard ran a drill unprompted. Morra watched from the walkway. Said nothing.

dialogues.text: Someone propped open the eastern gate. With a bucket. A bucket, Overlord.
Two goblins and my professional pride. The goblins will recover.

DECK_JSON.prompt: A hero cleared my floor. My traps. My patrols. My protocols. I want an explanation.

nextCard.cardText: It was Kargoth. He needed the gate open. Didn't see the problem. Morra is very still right now.

dialogues.btn: What could go wrong in an hour?
dialogues.text: Last time I took an hour, Greenfang tried to reroute the lava.
Properly? I genuinely cannot remember.

nextCard.cardText: Six more hours, no complaint. Then she sat down in the war room and didn't move for a day.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Four days without sleep. The dungeon runs perfectly. I need one hour. Don't break anything.

dialogues.text: Three crates of iron filings, a month of rations, and my best rope. For a ritual. My rope.
He says yes. The rope is gone regardless.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The Shadow Priest requisitioned my supply stores for a ritual. Without asking. I want his tongue or an apology. Either is fine.

dialogues.btn: Can we reach him in time?
dialogues.text: The window is narrow. Risk is considerable.
Enough to know when they were coming. Twice.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My spy inside the Order is blown. He's asking for extraction. Pull him out and we lose three years of access.

dialogues.text: Depends what you plan to do with the answer.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I know who the traitor is. Someone you trust. They don't know I know yet.

dialogues.btn: Why are you telling me this?
dialogues.text: Someone should have to know. Might as well be you.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I went back to the village. They rebuilt. There are children now. My orders stand. You should know what that means.

dialogues.text: More than most things here. Less than I'd like.
To stop. Same as me, most days.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I can end the eastern clan war. One meeting, no blood. I know their chief. This offer won't come again.

dialogues.text: Something is making informed decisions. Whether that's good depends what it decides next.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Zero casualties. Zero breaches. Intruders turn back on their own. Something saw this floor and decided against.

dialogues.text: Whoever it is, they're very good. Almost as good as me. I find that personally offensive.

nextCard.cardText: Trap closed. One suspect didn't look surprised. Vex is certain. She's waiting for your word.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Someone on my patrols is leaking routes. Never written down. Narrowed to four. Can't go further without tipping my hand.

dialogues.text: Whatever I'm bound to. Which is a great deal, none of it optional.
Everything can be reversed. The cost is the question.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Three soldiers who touched me have faint marks now. They don't know what they mean. I do.

dialogues.text: I've spent a very long time trying to determine that.

dialogues.btn: How long has it been counting?
dialogues.text: Since before counting existed. It invented the practice.

nextCard.cardText: The count finished. Nothing happened. The Branded said: it was satisfied. For the first time, he looked relieved.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The thing Vex watched — I've seen it before. It's not waiting. It's counting. The count is almost done.

dialogues.btn: What did the last person lose?
dialogues.text: They couldn't say after. They just looked different.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I can end what lives in the deep. The cost is something irreplaceable. Not gold. Something you can't name until it's gone.

dialogues.btn: Which do you think it is?
dialogues.text: I think it's the second. I'm hoping it's the first.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My protocols ran perfectly. Hero still got through. Either there's a flaw I can't find, or someone used the system against us.

dialogues.text: She's correct. That's not the whole problem.
That she makes the dungeon feel less survivable just standing still. Also correct.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Best fighter in my unit by a wide margin. Also why three others want transfers. Both sides are right.

leftChoice.text: Keep the fighter, let the others go

dialogues.text: Everything I can verify checks out.
Safety. He said it very quietly.

nextCard.cardText: Taken three days later. Intelligence died with him. Morra filed no report. Adjusted the watch. Said nothing.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Surface deserter at the gates. Real intelligence on the Sun-King. Family on the surface who don't know he's gone.
